name: Home Assistant
creator: NanoKVM Community
desc: Touch tiles for Home Assistant: toggle lights and switches, run scenes and scripts, and read sensors.

HA_TOKEN.label: Access token
HA_TOKEN.description: Long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile, under Security.

HA_URL.label: Home Assistant URL
HA_URL.description: Address of your Home Assistant. .local names work.

HA_ENTITIES.label: Entities
HA_ENTITIES.description: Optional. Pages of entities, for example: Living: light.sofa=Sofa, switch.tv; Climate: sensor.temperature. JSON such as {"Living": {"Sofa": "light.sofa"}} also works. Leave empty to show lights, switches, scenes and more automatically.

HA_REFRESH.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
HA_REFRESH.description: How often the visible tiles are updated.
